justification: New interpretation layer is pure threshold logic over existing metrics — no DB queries, no external APIs, no user-facing text (interpretation consumed by API clients/frontend, not displayed in this service). Additive change: existing TerrainResponse gains optional field, no breaking changes.

pre_impl.existing_data: Reads from terrain_dict (computed in-process by _run_terrain_chain) — no DB interaction
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If terrain_dict keys are missing, each _interpret_* function is guarded: missing landform/aspect/daylight/elevation/ruggedness -> finding omitted. Missing slope -> entire interpretation returns None.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New optional field on TerrainResponse — existing callers unaffected (interpretation defaults to None)
pre_impl.external_source_error: N/A — no external sources in interpretation layer
pre_impl.frontend_type: N/A — TerrainResponse is additive, Optional field
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: N/A — interpretation is additive. If it fails, raw terrain data still returned.

functions.name: _build_terrain_interpretation
functions.output: Optional[TerrainInterpretation] model included in TerrainResponse JSON

functions.name: _interpret_gradient
functions.input: dict containing slope_mean_deg and slope_max_deg float values
functions.output: TerrainFinding Pydantic model with severity GREEN/AMBER/RED
functions.if_none: slope values default to 0.0 via or 0.0

functions.name: _interpret_landform
functions.input: dict containing landform_type string and drainage_direction string
functions.if_none: landform defaults to flat, drainage to downslope

functions.name: _interpret_aspect
functions.output: TerrainFinding — slope < 2 = GREEN regardless of aspect

functions.name: _interpret_solar
functions.input: dict with daylight_fraction (required — only called if not None)
functions.output: TerrainFinding with derating percentage in narrative
functions.if_none: Not called if daylight_fraction missing (guarded in builder)

functions.name: _interpret_elevation
functions.input: dict with elevation_min_m, elevation_max_m, elevation_range_m, landform_type
functions.output: TerrainFinding — compounds with landform for low-lying variant
functions.if_none: Defaults to 0.0 for elevations. Not called if elevation_min_m missing.

functions.name: _interpret_ruggedness
functions.input: dict with terrain_ruggedness (required — only called if not None)
functions.if_none: Not called if terrain_ruggedness missing (guarded in builder)

values.if_missing: Solar finding omitted from findings list
Landform finding omitted from findings list

break_it.scenario: Unknown landform_type string not in _LANDFORM_SEVERITY dict
break_it.what_happens: Falls back to AMBER severity via dict.get default, uses slope narrative template

break_it.scenario: Slope exactly at boundary (e.g. mean=5.0, max=10.0) — off-by-one in threshold
break_it.what_happens: Could classify as wrong tier, affecting action_trigger and cost advice
break_it.how: Boundary tests: test_boundary_gentle_moderate, test_boundary_moderate_steep verify < vs >= behavior

break_it.scenario: Aspect on flat site (slope < 2) classified as south-facing RED
break_it.what_happens: Flat site incorrectly flagged as solar-constrained
break_it.how: terrain_analysis.py:549 — slope < 2 check runs first, returns GREEN regardless of aspect direction

post_merge.manual_verify: No — pure logic, no external dependencies
